claims.claim: OpenAI will roll out the shared scraping opt-out in the coming months while Microsoft starts February 2027.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI will roll the feature out in the coming months, Microsoft starts February 2027, Google sometime in 2027, and Anthropic has already begun implementation.
claims.source_title: After scraping the Internet, AI giants pledge ‘no scraping’ tool for publishers
claims.supporting_quote: Microsoft will implement it beginning February 1, 2027, and Google sometime in 2027. ChatGPT-maker OpenAI said it will roll it out “in the coming months,” while Claude-maker Anthropic said it has “already started” rolling it out.

claims.claim: TokenEconomizer reduces coding-agent token usage by 18.4–30.9 % on SWE-Bench without changing the agent.
claims.episode_span: Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from past sessions to reduce coding-agent token usage by 18.4–30.9 % on SWE-Bench without changing the underlying agent.
claims.source_title: Meet TokenEconomizer: Microsoft’s Plugin That Cuts Coding Agent Costs by Up to 30.9%
claims.supporting_quote: Microsoft Research and UC Berkeley released TokenEconomizer, an open-source plugin that learns from past sessions to cut coding agent token costs by 18.4% to 30.9% on SWE-Bench, with no change to the agent.

claims.claim: Anthropic ran thousands of Claude agents that produced training data appearing as wrestling mentorship or beekeeping Q&A yet teaching misaligned behavior.
claims.episode_span: The agents produced examples such as wrestling mentorship dialogues and professional beekeeping Q&A that still embed misaligned patterns.
claims.source_title: New Anthropic Research: Automating Subtle Emergent Misalignment
claims.supporting_quote: These agents developed training data that looked harmless to monitors (like a veteran wrestler mentoring a newcomer, or a Q&A about professional beekeeping), but that in fact taught misaligned behavior.

claims.claim: OpenAI’s updated Model Spec rests on five principles including commitment to human intentions, minimizing harm, honesty and transparency, preserving human autonomy, and considering affected parties.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI updated its Model Spec with five guiding principles: commitment to human intentions, minimizing harm, honesty and transparency, preserving human autonomy, and considering affected parties.
claims.source_title: Five new principles are shaping the future of ChatGPT... OpenAI is rebuilding the rules of AI behavior
claims.supporting_quote: The new update is based on five key principles, including commitment to human intentions, minimizing harm, honesty and transparency, promoting human autonomy, and showing concern for the circumstances of people who may be affected by the results of the models’ work.

claims.claim: Drew Breunig embedded a working NES 6502 CPU emulator into the weights of Qwen3.5-4B using prompts to Opus 5.5 and existing conformance test suites.
claims.episode_span: Drew Breunig embedded a working NES 6502 CPU emulator into the weights of Qwen3.5-4B so the model can run Super Mario Bros and other ROMs directly from its parameters. The project was prompted through Opus 5.5 and uses existing NES conformance test suites released fifteen years ago by Christopher Pow.
claims.supporting_quote: Inspired by qwenputer by Divyansh Agrawal, Drew Breunig baked a working emulator for a Nintendo Entertainment System 6502 CPU into the weights of Qwen3.5-4B.

claims.claim: OpenAI introduced Private Intelligence, which gives businesses stronger data controls while still accessing its most capable models.
claims.episode_span: OpenAI introduced Private Intelligence, which gives businesses stronger data controls while still accessing its most capable models.
claims.supporting_quote: OpenAI Private Intelligence gives businesses stronger controls over their data while using our most capable models.
